source.limitations: Not proof of the ranges loaded by Windows. Open size, antes and opponent response policies are not established by this export.

scope: Offline teaching examples: weighted ranges, blockers, current made-hand distribution and showdown equity. No recommended c-bet or solved full line.

hero_range_summary.nuts_definition: Maximum made-hand score among all legal hole combos on the CURRENT board; not a full future-equity tail.
hero_range_summary.distribution_normalization: Per-range weights after board removal; equity additionally conditions both private hands jointly.

range_vs_range.method: Independent weighted hole proposals, whole-pair collision rejection, uniform legal runout; win plus half ties
